scan.title: Crop Disease Scanner
scan.subtitle: Take clear photos of the affected leaves or plants.

result.preliminaryText: This AI result is based only on photos and can be wrong. It is not a lab test.
result.expertDefault: Show this crop to your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before using chemicals.

treatment.intro: Select what you will do. We will save it and remind you to check the crop.
